info.title: klint
info.description: Architecture-as-Code linting for TypeScript, Python, Swift, Rust, and C# projects, delivered as a .NET tool wrapping the native klint engine.

commands.name: install-skill
commands.description: Install the embedded klint-rules skill into agent config directories

options.name: --agents
options.description: Comma-separated: claude, codex, copilot, cursor, opencode (default: all)

options.name: --symlink
options.description: Keep one skill in .agents/skills and symlink the others to it (default)

options.name: --copy
options.description: Give every agent directory its own copy

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace a skill directory klint did not install

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
Asks which agents and how to store the skill when run on a terminal without
--agents, --symlink or --copy.

commands.name: stats
commands.description: Print runs, violations reported and errors prevented, in total and per rule

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
Set KLINT_NO_STATS=1 to stop recording.

options.name: --config
options.description: Directory containing klint.yaml or klint.config.json (default: cwd)

options.name: --fix
options.description: Apply autofixes, then report what is left

options.name: --hook
options.description: Count this run as an agent hook run in klint stats

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
With no command, lints the project.
